title: Acme business days (Sunday to Thursday)
spec: Implement business_days(start: date, end: date, holidays: Iterable[date] = ()) -> int.
Return the number of Acme working days in the INCLUSIVE range [start, end].
- Acme works Sunday to Thursday (Israel). Friday and Saturday are the weekend.
- A date in holidays is not a working day. A holiday that falls on a weekend changes nothing. The same holiday listed twice counts once. Holidays outside the range are ignored.
- If end is before start, return 0.
Example: Sunday 2026-11-01 to Saturday 2026-11-07 is 5 working days.
